name: 07853 · Long Valley, NJ
findings: ZIP 07853 (Long Valley) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07853 (Long Valley) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07853 (Long Valley) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
